aggregation_provenance.limitation: Native legacy risk.total_individual_risk and risk.fn_curve; expected-death convention; external physics/coverage must be checked separately.

timing.distribution: across cases in one campaign execution; p95/p99 are not repeated-run latency or service-level qualification

semantics.individual_risk: fixed person at each receptor; no population occupancy multiplier
semantics.societal_risk: native legacy F-N of expected deaths per event/weather/barrier/ignition outcome; not a joint casualty distribution
semantics.weighting: initiating frequency times annual joint condition times release/barrier branch times ignition; each once
semantics.endpoints: two declared radiation sensitivities and within-branch harm union bounds; not frequency credible intervals
semantics.population: disjoint outdoor groups at representative receptors; temporal presence in annual conditions
